# Shodh Dhara (शोध धारा)

> A UGC Care Listed, Quarterly Peer Reviewed, Bi-Lingual (Hindi & English) Research Journal of Arts & Humanities. Established 2005-06. ISSN: 0975-3664 | RNI: U.P.BIL/2012/43696.

Shodh Dhara is one of India's established academic research journals in the Arts & Humanities domain, published from Orai (Jalaun), Uttar Pradesh. It is listed under the UGC CARE framework, making it eligible for academic credit and recognition in Indian universities.

## Key Facts

- **Full Name:** Shodh Dhara (शोध धारा)
- **Type:** Quarterly Peer Reviewed, Referred, Bi-Lingual Research Journal
- **Languages:** Hindi and English
- **Subject:** Arts & Humanities
- **ISSN:** 0975-3664
- **RNI:** U.P.BIL/2012/43696
- **UGC CARE Listed:** Yes
- **Established:** 2005-06
- **Publisher:** Shaikshik Avam Anusandhan Sansthan, Orai (Jalaun), U.P. 285001
- **Publication Schedule:** Quarterly — January–March, April–June, July–September, October–December

## How to Submit a Paper

Authors can submit research papers via email to shodhdharajournal2005@gmail.com. Papers must be accompanied by a filled Declaration Form and must follow the Author Guidelines available at https://shodhdhara.com/guidelines/. The journal accepts original, unpublished research in Hindi and English in the fields of Arts & Humanities.

## Published Issues

All issues from #56 (2020) to the latest are available for download at https://shodhdhara.com/current-issue/
